result.topic_en: Notes proposing an arithmetic-algebraic definition of the division equation of elliptic functions via fields over the quadratic field of y, a plan to develop the Bessel function with its derivative in a ternary continued-fraction algorithm to prove irrationality, and the beginning of a remark on an alternative axiom to Euclid's.

items.quote:
Construire
zu dem quadratischen Körper $y=\sqrt{(x-\alpha_1)(x-\alpha_2)}$
$\overline{(x-\alpha_3)(x-\alpha_4)}$ alle Körper mit der Partialdiscri-
minante 1.
items.english: Construct, for the quadratic field y = sqrt((x-α1)(x-α2)(x-α3)(x-α4)), all fields with partial discriminant 1.

items.quote:
Dann suche den Körper $p^2$ten
Grades wo $p$ eine Primzahl ist.
items.english: Then look for the field of degree p^2 where p is a prime.

items.quote:
Studire überhaupt
die allgemeine Theorie der Einheiten in dem [?]
du dieselben im unendlich fernen nach Puiseux
entwickelst.
items.english: Study in general the theory of units, in which [?] you expand them at infinity according to Puiseux.

items.quote:
Entwickle die Besselsche Function simultan
mit ihrem Differentialquotienten in {+ternären+} einen Ketten-
bruchalgorismus, nicht gewöhnlichen Kettenbruch.
items.english: Expand the Bessel function simultaneously with its derivative in a ternary continued-fraction algorithm, not an ordinary continued fraction.
For this the homogeneous linear differential equation of 3rd order with only 2 critical points is necessary.

items.quote:
beweise damit dass die Besselsche
Function für rationale Argumente irrationale
Werthe annimmt.
items.english: Prove thereby that the Bessel function takes irrational values for rational arguments.
